releases.name: v0.3.1
releases.body:
## What's Changed
* First post-jam update
* Japanese translation by @TRSasasusu
* Put the floor back on in later parts of the mod
* Minor animation tweaks

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Hawkbat/ow-wrong-warp-nh-jam/compare/0.3.0...0.3.1
releases.bodyZh:
## 変更点
* 初回のjam後の更新
* @TRSasasusuによる日本語訳
* モードの後半部分に床を戻す
* 小さなアニメーション調整

**完全な変更履歴**: https://github.com/Hawkbat/ow-wrong-warp-nh-jam/compare/0.3.0...0.3.1

releases.name: v0.2.0
releases.body:
- Made black holes 93% less deadly, to avoid repeating long load times
- Added fuel canisters in certain locations
- Minor tweaks and graphical fixes

- 特定の場所に燃料カニスターを追加
- 小規模な調整とグラフィック修正
